svg.title: Nimitz class hangar deck, from DCS's models (ship coordinates: metres forward of the origin, metres to starboard)

g.text: Hangar deck, floor 8.71 m above the ship's origin. Bow to the right, starboard down. Numbers: metres forward of the origin (across), metres to starboard (down).

grey outline: the floor as drawn · blue: the floor as DCS's physics has it (Col_Hangar and the doorway sills), dashed: its walls · red: the drawn hangar cut 1.5 m above the floor · orange: cut at 0.3 m · grey: cut at 3.0 m · purple: the elevators' platforms
